hunks.added: Version 9 (October 28, 2026; this paper) corrects the deviation count R1–R6 to R1–R8, found by the deposit’s clean-room regeneration.

hunks.removed: Version 3’s update probes (superseded). Table 26 is version 3’s analysis of the update probes (pod sitting r6). Its sampling floor for the per-sample stream added the two methods’ variances as if their draws were independent, although the per-sample stream replays the literal stream’s line firings, so the floor was too large and every excess of the per-sample stream came out as zero. Version 4 replaces it by the paired analysis of Section 4.3 (Table 7). The surrogate’s verdicts did not depend on this floor.
